answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The willow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the mirror. The lantern of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
